canResync.description: Whether a resync can be triggered right now — use this to gate Resync actions. True when the account is sync-enabled, is in a resyncable status, is not a custom wallet, and has either a live credential of a syncable kind (api_key/address/account_name) or an enabled connection. False for CSV, custom and credential-less integrations. Computed at read time, not from `credentialKind` (which is a write-once snapshot that records csv as `none`), so it follows credentials being added or revoked. Omitted from `?fields=summary` list responses.

latestSync.description: Most recent sync (any status). Populated on GET responses; null if never synced.

triggerType.description: Collapses triggerSource into manual/automated. 'automated' only for the scheduled auto-sync worker; every other source (manual trigger, retry, reconnect, webhook, initial account setup) is manual.

limitReached.description: True when the run stopped early because the workspace hit its transaction limit: rows fetched before the cut are saved, the rest were never read — so this wallet's history is incomplete. `status: partially_synced` alone does NOT mean this (a failed connector function produces the same status), which is why this is a separate field. Raising the cap does not backfill anything on its own: an incremental sync resumes from the last transaction it wrote, so the integration must be re-synced with `syncMode: resync_from_start`. This is the v2 replacement for v1's `limitExceeded`.

transactionsDeletedAt.description: Set once the transactions this run imported were deleted via `DELETE /sync/{syncId}/transactions`. The row stays in history.

credentials.description: Populated on GET responses for address/account_name integrations only (secrets masked); null for secret kinds.

csvUploads.description: Upload history for CSV-type integrations, most recent first. Empty for non-CSV integrations. Populated on GET /integrations/{id} only. Same shape as GET /csv/uploads.

filePath.description: GCS object path — pass this to the signed-URL endpoint to download the file.

txnCounts.description: Per-integration transaction counts (from client_metadata, refreshed by the recompute pipeline). Null until first computed. Per-asset breakdown is at GET /integrations/{id}/assets.

netValue.description: Net holdings value of the integration in the workspace base currency.

hasMissingBalance.description: True if any asset's calculated (ledger-derived) balance differs from the provider-reported balance by more than 0.01 — same query as the `hasMissingBalance` filter and GET /integrations/{id}/missing-balances, so all three agree. Evaluated live per request, so it never lags the filter it accompanies. Only integrations that actually report balances are compared: a CSV/manual integration has no provider-reported holdings, so it is treated as unverifiable (false) rather than as reporting zero.

assetLogos.description: Up to 5 distinct asset logo URLs held by this integration. Populated in list responses

assetCount.description: Total distinct (non-spam, unless includeSpam) assets held by this integration — use with assetLogos to render a '+N' overflow badge beyond the 5-logo cap. Populated in list responses.

txnCount.description: Total distinct transactions for this integration (`txnCounts.total`).
